description: Change the risk register (editor+; accept is admin): create a risk assessment, update one, delete one (destructive), or record or renew a risk acceptance. Pick with method.

control_id.description: SCF control ID to link (e.g., 'AST-01') — obtain from scf_list_controls Used by: create.

expires_on.description: Date the acceptance lapses (YYYY-MM-DD); must be after today (400 otherwise) Used by: accept.

impact.description: Inherent impact on a 1–5 scale Used by: create, update.

likelihood.description: Inherent likelihood on a 1–5 scale Used by: create, update.

method.description:
create: Create a new risk assessment in the risk register (write — editor+ role). Likelihood and impact scores populate the 5×5 risk matrix.
update: Update a scored risk by code (write — editor). Only passed fields change. Setting accepted records no approval (use scf_accept_risk); re-scoring an accepted risk clears its approval.
delete: Delete an organization's scoring of a risk code (destructive write — editor role). The catalog or custom risk definition itself remains; only this org's assessment row is removed.
accept: Accept a risk (write — admin): records you as approver, now, the rationale and expiry. Renews an accepted risk. Also accepts a standards exception. A platform key without a user gets 403.

notes.description: Free-text notes on this risk assessment Used by: update.

owner.description: Name or identifier of the risk owner Used by: create.

owner_user_id.description: Risk owner — obtain from scf_list_members Used by: update.

rationale.description: Why the risk is accepted (required, non-blank; stored trimmed). Blank is refused Used by: accept.

residual_impact.description: Residual impact after treatment, 1–5 scale Used by: update.

residual_likelihood.description: Residual likelihood after treatment, 1–5 scale Used by: update.

risk_code.description: Risk code — catalog R-XX-N or custom R-ORG-N [update, delete] | Risk code — catalog R-XX-N or custom R-ORG-N — obtain from scf_list_risks or scf_list_custom_risks [accept] Used by: update, delete, accept.

title.description: Risk title (required, max ~100 chars) Used by: create.

treatment_plan.description: How the risk is being treated Used by: update.

treatment_status.description: Treatment workflow status (default identified) [create] | Treatment lifecycle state. 'accepted' set here records no approval — scf_accept_risk does. Below admin, moving an accepted risk with an approval in force off accepted is ignored (it stays accepted); an admin's move clears the acceptance [update] Used by: create, update.

name: scf_risk_write
